findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: The triple sink was tested and recorded at 50ppm at the start of the inspection. PIC was made aware and emptied the triple sink and refilled it and created a new sanitizer solution. The new solution was tested and recorded at 100ppm chlorine. Ensure the triple sink is tested and changed at a frequency necessary to maintain the sanitizer’s efficacy. 
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum temperature (55F), concentration (100ppm), and pH (10). (B) Iodine shall have 68F, pH of 5 or less and concentration of 12.5ppm and 25ppm. (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have 75F, concentration based on label, and water with 500ppm hardness or less. (D) - (E) Meets EPA-label use and regulatory authority approval. (P) (F) Other chemical sanitzers in-use shall have EPA-registered label, display device registration number on devide and is operated and maintained in accordance with manufacturers instructions (Pf)

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.13: The coving near the triple sink near the roaster is observed to have come unattached from the wall. Ensure repairs are made to the coving to create a smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable surface. 
6-201.13: (A) floor and wall junctures shall be coved and closed to no larger than 1mm (one thirty-second inch). (B) Floors in which water flush cleaning methods are used shall be provided with drains and be graded to drain. Floor and wall junctures shall be coved and SEALED.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The inside wall of the ice machine is observed to have an accumulation of mildew/build-up. This surface was pointed out to the PIC and was immediately cleaned and sanitized. PIC stated this item will now be on the cleaning radar list. Ensure these surfaces remain cleaned and sanitized at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean.
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
6-202.15: The back entrance door is observed to have visible light shining through the bottom where a gap is present. The facility needs to have maintenance performed on the door that allows it to shut and latch properly and to create a seal to prevent the entry of pests.
6-202.15: (A) Outer openings of FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall be protected against entry of insects and rodents. (B) Does not apply to FOOD ESTABLISHMENTS which opens into larger structure. (C) Exterior doors need not be self-closing if designed for limited-use. (D) If opening present, opening shall be protected against rodent and insects. (E) Paragraph (D) not applicable when pests are absent.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment: 6-501.12: There is observed coffee beans on the floor near the coffee grinder/storage/roasting area. These beans are observed under the table, under the pallets, and variously throughout the floor. Ensure this area is cleaned at a frequency with enough detail to keep it clean. 6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The ice scoop storage container was observed to have contaminants and other liquids besides water in the base of the container in contact with the ice scoop. This item was removed from service and placed into the wash, rinse, sanitize cycle and a fresh container was placed. Ensure the ice scoop and container are clean to sight and touch.
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: The mop sink is observed to be in need of caulking along the back wall where the basin meets the wall with a visible gap present. Ensure these repairs are made to create a smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable surface. 
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: The caulking was observed to be degrading at the back prep sink that is not currently in use as well as around the hand sink near the triple sink by the basement stairs. This poses the potential to reduce the effectiveness of cleaning and therefore required the need to be corrected. Ensure caulking is replaced and added to ensure the surface is sealed properly as well as smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable.
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.
